Card Q&A.q: Can this card's inherited effect return 2 non-Digi-Egg cards from the trash to the bottom of the deck, but then allow the deletion?

Effect: [When Digivolving] ＜Draw 2＞. Then, trash 2 cards in your hand. If [Garurumon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Garurumon] or [Omnimon] in its name would be deleted in battle, by returning 2 non-Digi-Egg cards from your trash to the bottom of the deck, prevent that deletion.
